messages.subject: updateCheckboxGroupInput and updateCheckboxInput update differently
parts:
Dear all,

Is there any explanations  why "updateCheckboxGroupInput" and "updateCheckboxInput" are
different in selection update?

"updateCheckboxInput" updates "label" and "value", while 
"updateCheckboxGroupInput" updates only "choices" but not "selected" in the same simple code ( code is below and attached ).

Have somebody an idea?
Thank you in advance,
Kirill Essine


#**************************updateCheckboxInput*************************

library(shiny)
ui <-  mainPanel(
 
    checkboxInput( inputId = "Update",
                            label   = "Update selection",
                           value   = FALSE),
   
    checkboxInput( inputId  = "Select",
                              label  = "A",
                             value  = FALSE)
)

server <- function(input, output,session) {
 
  observeEvent (input$Update, {

     if(input$Update) {
      
       updateCheckboxInput(
                    session  = session,
                      inputId  = "Select",
                         label  = "B",
                        value  = TRUE)
     }
  })
 
}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

#**************************updateCheckboxGroupInput*************************
library(shiny)
ui <-  mainPanel(
 
    checkboxInput( inputId = "Update",
                    label   = "Update selection",
                   value   = FALSE),
   
    checkboxGroupInput( inputId  = "Select",
                     label  = "Select",
                 choices  = c("A"=1,"B"=2),
                 selected = c(1,2),
                      inline = TRUE)
)

server <- function(input, output,session) {
 
  observeEvent (input$Update, {

     if(input$Update) {
      
       updateCheckboxGroupInput(
             session  = session,
              inputId  = "Select",
                 label  = NULL,
            choices  = c("C"=3,"D"=4),
            selected = c(3,4),
                 inline = TRUE)
     }
  })
 
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
